component.name: bARMbu Studio Helper
component.summary: Run Bambu Lab's network plugin on ARM Linux

description.p: Bambu Lab only builds Bambu Studio's network plugin for regular x86 PCs. This app sets up an x86 copy of Bambu Studio that runs under FEX emulation on ARM computers such as Apple Silicon Macs with Asahi Linux, and installs the official plugin inside it.
